name: generation
note: NPP state file (data/raw/npp/npp_state_generation_fy.csv): conventional stations only (CEA 18-column reports: coal and lignite, gas, diesel, nuclear, hydro), no renewables. Generation is recorded in the state where the plant stands, not where the power is used. Sources summed per state and year; subtotal and partial-year rows left out

name: population_and_gsdp
note: challenge dataset (data/raw/competition/renewable_energy_dataset.csv), years FY2018-19..FY2023-24; a GSDP equal to the year before is a placeholder and that state-year is left out; the 2024 GSDP is not used; names matched with normalize_state only; GSDP at constant 2011-12 prices (states listed in data/external/macro/gsdp_price_basis.csv are at current prices and are deflated with the MoSPI GDP deflator, secondary)

name: slope
note: within (state fixed effects) OLS of ln(generation per person) on ln(GSDP per person), FY2018-19..FY2023-24. Diagnostic only, never used by the forecast

name: se
note: conventional OLS s.e., n_obs - n_states - 1 degrees of freedom, not clustered by state

name: n_obs
note: state-years in the regression

name: n_states
note: states with at least one state-year in the regression

name: n_skipped
note: ladakh: in the NPP state file, not in the challenge dataset; skipped, generation not assigned to any other state

name: left_out_zero_generation
note: matched state-years with no generation in the NPP file

name: left_out_stale_gsdp
note: matched state-years with GSDP equal to the year before

name: left_out_no_data
note: matched state-years with no dataset population or GSDP

name: india_beta
note: the elasticity the forecast uses: national, NPP all-India generation (all sources) per person on GSDP per person, FY2011-12..FY2023-24

name: national_gen_kwh_per_person
note: all NPP state rows (matched or not) over the dataset's total population, FY2018-19..FY2023-24 totals; same conventional-only basis as the states

name: ratio_min
note: nagaland (states with generation)

name: ratio_max
note: sikkim

name: sd_ln_ratio
note: s.d. across states of ln(state / national), states with generation

name: states_without_generation
note: goa

name: between_share_ln_gen
note: share of the variance of ln(generation per person) in the regression sample that lies between states (absorbed by the state effects)

name: between_share_ln_income
note: the same for ln(GSDP per person)

name: goa
note: no generation in the window: not in the regression
goa: no generation in 6 of 6 years in the NPP state file; those years are not in the regression
ladakh: in the NPP state file, not in the challenge dataset; skipped (its generation is not assigned to any other state)
in the challenge dataset with no NPP generation rows: chandigarh
